description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Poland Poland nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when nationwide statutory holiday list only. Saturday substitute dates, individual work schedules, employer, sector, school, bank and local schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Poland: Christmas Eve. | Poland: Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-12-24"} | {"date":"2026-10-27"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/poland-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/poland-public-working-day.md
name: check_pl_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Poland nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Poland's statutory named holidays and Sundays are included; regional, employer, school, bank and sector schedules are not inferred.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: When a statutory holiday falls on Saturday for a five-day-week employee, an additional day off may be due within the settlement period; the employer and work schedule determine the date, so no substitute date is inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Poland Working Day
